description:
Hi! I’m Lwin Min Aung, a cybersecurity researcher, penetration tester, and technical instructor. I specialize in offensive security, vulnerability assessment, and building custom automation pipelines in Python and Bash.

Join my team if you love high-efficiency engineering, rapid prototyping, and solving complex technical challenges.

Looking for: Full-stack/backend developers, AI/agentic workflow enthusiasts, and driven builders ready to create something impactful!
